items.q: I used to tell Charlie why don't you leave here and travel around, no, he stayed at Small's and I used to have a band at Small's on Sundays

ctx.x: Yeah, he used 'Nola' for his theme song.
I used to tell Charlie why don't you leave here and travel around, no, he stayed at Small's and I used to have a band at Small's on Sundays, Sunday afternoon.
I used to have a band and one day Duke came in there and I called -- I said, go get this guy, what's his name, trumpet player. He was playing downtown at a dancing school and I --
